summary.intent: Plan and execute Wave 5 of the CipherBox v2 rewrite (recon, tracker hygiene, dispatch 7 PRs, drive review cycles overnight without merging), then handle post-merge rebases, tracker corrections, Wave 6 planning, a #648 issue split, and a staging-infrastructure cleanup (env var renames, secret rotation, SSH deploy key rotation after a VPS reimage).
summary.outcome: All 7 Wave 5 PRs were reviewed, resolved, merged, and main verified green; a semantic ResealError merge conflict was fixed during rebase; tracker hygiene (#1014 forensics, #1107/#1108 filed, #648 split into 4 sequenced issues) completed; Wave 6 plan (8 PRs) written; staging env vars renamed off the STAGING_ prefix, redis/tee-worker retired, gateway var renamed to IPFS_GATEWAY_URL, and DB_PASSWORD/SSH_KEY secrets rotated after confirming a legitimate VPS reimage via host-key fingerprint comparison.

repo: Squash-merge repo: branch tips are never ancestors of main, so 'is it merged' must be checked via PR state, not git reachability.
GitHub REST `.parent` field on issues always returns null (false negative) — must use the GraphQL/sub-issues API and parent orphaned issues before judging any umbrella issue's completeness.
macroscope check-runs 'completed' includes 'skipped' (e.g. credit exhaustion) — coverage detection must check conclusion/output.title, not just completion.
macroscope can post findings well after its check-runs complete (seen: 9 minutes after) — re-query threads before declaring a PR clean.

A seam trait with only test-fake implementors compiles and passes tests while reading as delivered — audit by checking whether any impl exists outside a #[cfg(test)] module, and whether the primitive has any production caller at all.
`Web E2E Smoke Result` required check is flaky at smoke.spec.ts:43 ('signing out returns the tab to the front door') and blocks unrelated PRs; a same-commit rerun clears it.
GitHub environment-scoped variables API paginates at 10 per page by default with no warning — must pass per_page=100 or compare against .total_count, or vars past the 10th silently appear missing.
GitHub Actions secrets are write-only (no read endpoint via API or UI) — rotation requires generate-and-set, not extract-and-copy.

Postgres only applies POSTGRES_PASSWORD on an empty/fresh data volume — rotating DB_PASSWORD against an existing volume desyncs the API from the live role unless paired with ALTER USER (unless the volume itself is being recreated).

SSH deploy key rotation requires appending the new public key to authorized_keys and verifying login with the new key alone (agent disabled) before setting the CI secret, to avoid locking the pipeline out.
docker-compose.staging.yml can reference ${VAR} names that are simply absent from the generated .env.staging, causing services to silently start with empty values (e.g. redis --requirepass '').

code.finding: reseal_verdict maps ResealError variants to WritePublishError; PR #1101 rewrote this as an exhaustive match with no catch-all, which then had to gain a `TooManyCommittedGrants` arm to compile against #1098's new variant — a genuine semantic (not textual) merge conflict.

WriteSubtreeResolver trait doc still says 'the real network/gate wiring is not landed and tests fake it' — only test fakes exist (FakeResolver/PostFlipResolver/FailingResolver at :761/:784/:805); no open issue tracked its production impl until #1108 was filed.

Module doc lists which seam traits have production vs faked impls — this exact paragraph is what the #1014 audit used to find untracked gaps, and it required a genuine 3-way merge (not a union) during #1103's rebase to stay accurate.
PRODUCTION.chunk_size = 1_048_536 is deliberate, not a typo: sealed leaf is exactly 1 MiB, so plaintext chunk = 1MiB - NONCE_LEN(24) - TAG_LEN(16), per crates/core/src/suite/aead.rs:103.

Command::Grant lives at :465 (not :459 as originally misread); catch-all unimplemented arm is at :2278; 9 Command variants fall through but only 7 are in scope for #1016 (ManualRefresh and Logout belong to sync/session slices).

gateway-read scenario already fails closed with an explicit error when LOAD_TEST_GATEWAY_URL is unset on a deployed target — not a silent-empty-target bug as initially assumed, just a late failure after a release build.

workflow: Set an explicit non-merge boundary before unattended overnight work ('handle the reviews till I wake up' does not imply merge authority) and state it up front.

Build and compile combined N-way merges of parallel PRs in a scratch worktree before trusting `mergeable=MERGEABLE` — textually-clean merges can still fail to compile (semantic conflicts) and this is invisible to any single PR's CI.

Never apply a reviewer's (CodeRabbit/macroscope) suggested diff literally — verify the mechanism first; three suggestions this session would have been worse than the bug (deriving Debug on a Zeroizing secret type, clear_session causing a DoS, a helper that ignores its params).
Read exit codes directly/unpiped (`cmd; echo $?` not `cmd | tail; echo $?`) — piping masks the real command's exit status.
Give parallel/worktree agents unique scratchpad file paths — a shared scratchpad directory causes agents to clobber each other's PR-body drafts silently.

When rotating a host's SSH deploy key after suspected host-key change, verify the new fingerprint out-of-band (e.g. via cloud provider's browser console) against the live host before trusting any SSH-based read — treat a changed host key as a hard stop until independently corroborated.

Diagnose 'connection refused' methodically rather than assuming a firewall/ban: check sshd listening, ufw/iptables/nft rules, and journalctl auth logs for the actual source IP before hypothesizing csf/fail2ban.

Verify a rotated secret's downstream consumer (e.g. deployed .env.staging) will pick up the new value before assuming the rotation is complete — some values self-heal on next deploy, others need a paired manual step (DB ALTER USER, authorized_keys).

friction: Repeated transient network outages during the overnight session (GitHub API connection refused, intermittent) requiring retry/backoff logic and a connectivity-recovery notifier.
zsh vs bash differences caused silent bugs: unquoted $EXP not word-splitting in a loop, causing three fingerprints to be compared as one string.
gh CLI quirks: `gh api --arg` invalid, `--jq 'as $d|...'` syntax errors on arrays, requiring workarounds.
Fleet concurrency limit (20 subagents) made /simplify, /security-review, /crypto-privacy-review subagents unavailable for one PR, requiring manual passes instead.

Self-inflicted SSH lockout scare: retrying SSH connections after a host-key-verification failure was initially misdiagnosed as fail2ban/firewall blocking, when it was actually local network flakiness affecting the same egress IP seen in GitHub API failures.
Hostinger hPanel has no UI surface for SSH host fingerprints, requiring a browser console workaround.
macroscope ran out of credits mid-wave, silently downgrading review coverage on 6 of 7 PRs until the script's detection was fixed to recognize 'skipped' as non-coverage.
